paras: Upgrade your Subaru WRX , Forester , or Toyota 86 GT 's rear braking performance with DIXCEL brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. DIXCEL rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the DIXCEL brake rotor types shown for the 5x100 stud pattern Subaru and Toyota platform vehicles fitted with the solid rear brake setup, including the Subaru WRX (GR/GH) 2008-2014 non-Brembo variants, the Forester (SH) 2008-2013, and the Toyota 86 GT (ZN6) base trim. All rotors for this application are 286x10mm solid . Multiple rotor types are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the comparison chart on this product page to select the rotor type best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
hl: Hole Pattern: 5+2+1 (5-stud with 2 location holes and 1 sensor hole)
